build_transformer_encoder: build a Transformer encoder model with configurable d_model, n_layers, n_heads, and dropout ratio
build_transformer_decoder: build a TransformerDecoder model with greedy inference or cross-entropy training mode
create_attention_layer: create a MultiHead attention layer with configurable heads, causal masking, and dropout
create_positional_encodings: create sinusoidal positional encodings for a given tensor shape using positional_encodings_like
build_encoder_decoder_pipeline: build an encoder-decoder pipeline using Transformer and TransformerDecoder for sequence generation
